user.title: Log in to ICA
user.description: Log in with the personnummer and password you use in the ICA app. BankID-only accounts are not supported – set a password at ica.se first. Home Assistant must run on a Swedish IP address.

list.title: Choose list
list.description: Pick the ICA list to sync and the Home Assistant to-do list to sync it with.

data.remove_striked: Clear checked items after every sync

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to ICA again
reauth_confirm.description: ICA rejected the stored login. Enter your personnummer and password again.

reauth_list.title: Choose list
reauth_list.description: The previously configured list could not be found on this account. Pick the list to sync.

error.invalid_auth: Wrong personnummer or password (or the account only supports BankID).
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach ICA. Try again later.
error.geo_blocked: ICA blocks requests from outside Sweden (HTTP 451). Home Assistant must run on a Swedish IP address.
error.no_lists: The account has no shopping lists. Create one in the ICA app first.

init.title: ICA Shopping Configuration
init.description: Changing the list may sync existing to-do items to the new ICA list. Check the list first if needed. The store is used by the On Sale sensor (your favourite stores in the ICA app).

data.remove_striked: Clear checked items after every sync

data_description.never_add: Pantry staples that ica_shopping.plan_dinners skips, matched on the ingredient name.

not_logged_in.message: ICA Shopping is not logged in. Re-authenticate under Settings → Devices & Services → ICA Shopping.

no_recipes.message: ICA returned no recipes (source: {source}). Favorites need at least one saved recipe in the ICA app.

calendar_not_writable.message: {entity_id} can't create events. Pick a calendar that supports new events, such as Local Calendar, Google Calendar or CalDAV.

calendar_event_failed.message: Couldn't add the dinners to the calendar ({error}). {created} of {total} events were created, and {added} ingredients were already added to {list}, so don't run the action again without removing them first.

no_favorite_store.message: No favourite store found. Add a store in the ICA app and pick it under Settings → Devices & Services → ICA Shopping.

not_loaded.message: ICA Shopping is not loaded yet. Try again in a moment.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Sync the ICA shopping list with the configured to-do list in both directions.

clear_checked.name: Clear checked items
clear_checked.description: Sync, then delete checked-off rows from the ICA list and completed items from the to-do list.

get_offers.name: Get offers
get_offers.description: Return the favourite store's current offers and the bonus balance.

get_memory.name: Get dinner memory
get_memory.description: Return the saved dinner history and preferences.

set_preference.name: Remember a preference
set_preference.description: Remember a dinner preference, e.g. 'Oskar: ingen fisk'.

remove_preference.name: Forget a preference
remove_preference.description: Remove a saved preference (matched on the text).

plan_dinners.name: Plan dinners
plan_dinners.description: Pick ICA recipes and add their merged ingredients to a shopping list. Returns the menu. With preview=true the list is left untouched.

source.name: Source
source.description: Random ICA recipes, or recipes you have saved as favorites in the ICA app.

list.name: List
list.description: ICA list name. Defaults to the synced list; a name that doesn't exist is created.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.description: Optional. Adds one all-day event per dinner on consecutive days, with the cooking time, recipe link and ingredients.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: Day of the first dinner in the calendar. Defaults to tomorrow.

preview.name: Preview
preview.description: Return the menu and the merged ingredients without adding anything to the list.

recipes.name: Recipe ids
recipes.description: Recipe ids to use, e.g. '123,456'. Overrides count and source, so exactly the previewed menu is added.

avoid_days.name: Avoid recent days
avoid_days.description: Skip recipes eaten within this many days. 0 turns it off.

list_full.title: ICA list is full
list_full.description: The ICA list has reached its limit of {limit} rows, so {count} new item(s) from the to-do list weren't added: {skipped}. Checked-off rows count toward the limit. Run the **ica_shopping.clear_checked** action, or turn on "Clear checked items after every sync" in the integration's options. This message disappears after the next sync that fits.
